messages:
alicia: quick follow-up from the authz incident last night — thanks everyone who triaged. we still have open remediations: token validation edge case, a few stale permission roles, audit log gaps for 02:10-02:45 UTC, and secrets rotation verification for the service account that failed.

devin: +1. I can take token validation. planning to add extra unit tests and a small integration test against the token service.

samir: i'll own the permission cleanup. i want a list of roles to deprecate first — can someone drop that here or in the doc?

linda: i'll re-ingest the audit logs and look for missing events. have a local script but will run against prod export; giving a heads-up that it may generate load.

sec-bot: IncidentRunbook created: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/authz-2026-03|authz-2026-03>

alicia: thanks. Devin, can you target a PR by EOD Friday? we should have a short canary job before rolling.

devin: yes — PR by Fri EOD. plan: add these checks:
```
- enforce `exp` and `iat` presence
- reject tokens with skew > 60s
- validate issuer claim against allowed list
```
will also add integration test that hits the token validator container image.

samir: timeline for role cleanup? i'd prefer a staged approach: mark roles deprecated -> monitor 2 weeks -> remove. propose start Mon and mark owners for each role.

linda: re-ingest window scheduled for Thu 03:00 UTC. i'll post expected load numbers. if anyone objects to timing speak now.

devin: can we add a short runtime check that logs malformed tokens to a dedicated debug logger (not user-facing) so we can replay without spamming metrics?

alicia: yes — devin add a debug log channel and a flag guarded by config so it's easy to toggle. also add a migration note to the runbook with rollout steps.

sec-bot: AuditExport job queued: job id 0x8f3a. ETA 45m.

samir: i dropped the initial role list here: <https://redwood.internal/docs/role-audit-2026-03|role-audit-2026-03>. assigning owners inline:
- billing_read -> @linda
- legacy_admin -> @samir
- service_observer -> @devin

linda: ack on billing_read. will review usage logs and flag any active principals by Tue.

devin: ack service_observer. i'll add a short deprecation notice to the API and a monitoring alarm for access counts.

alicia: good. for secrets rotation: @linda please verify the rotation completed for service-account-alpha and report checksum mismatch if any. if rotation failed we fallback to emergency key and rotate again.

linda: running rotation verification now. command I'm using:
```
kms-cli verify --key service-account-alpha --env prod --expect-hash abc123def
```
will post results in ~15m.

sec-bot: RotationAudit: service-account-alpha -> OK

alicia: excellent. final items for tracking (please confirm ownership/due dates):
- token validation fixes -> @devin -> PR by Fri EOD (2005012345)
- permission deprecations -> @samir -> mark deprecated Mon, monitor 2 weeks
- audit log re-ingest & gap fixes -> @linda -> Thu 03:00 UTC re-ingest, report by Thu 06:00 UTC
- secrets rotation verification -> @linda -> completed (sec-bot shows OK)

devin: confirmed.

samir: confirmed.

linda: confirmed, i'll post the final audit re-ingest summary in this thread after it's done.

alicia: one more ask — ops team, can we add this incident to the recurring incident pattern tracker? looks like similar authz token skew issues twice in last quarter. want to schedule a retrospective with infra in two weeks.

ops-bot: Added to recurring-incident-tracker, incident id RIT-2026-17. Retrospective scheduled: 2026-04-05 16:00 UTC.

alicia: thanks all. i'll convert these into action items in the postmortem doc and ping owners tomorrow for a brief sync. please update the runbook if you add any commands or flags.

devin: will do a follow-up PR link here when ready.

linda: re-ingest done, summary: found 18 missing events, replayed successfully, no checksum issues. posting details to the runbook. :white_check_mark:

samir: role cleanup plan documented, will start deprecation notices Mon.

alicia: closing loop for this thread — next check-in on Fri EOD for PRs and Wed next week for monitoring results. thanks :thumbsup:
